intervals.locator: arXiv:2506.20545 abstract ("under development at the future FAIR facility"); arXiv:2004.11762: FAIR "is under construction"
intervals.note: FAIR sources say FAIR "is under construction"; the 2025 CBM paper calls CBM "a next-generation heavy-ion experiment under development at the future FAIR facility". No source states when CBM construction began; April 2020 is the date of the earliest status paper read (arXiv:2004.11762), whose 2025 first-beam expectation has since slipped, and the 2025 commissioning of SIS100 is scheduled for 2H 2027 (arXiv:2510.14948).
intervals.quote: The Compressed Baryonic Matter (CBM) experiment is a next-generation heavy-ion experiment under development at the future FAIR facility in Darmstadt, Germany.
